description.basis: existing geographic and literary sources associated with this place

texts.en: The coastal tower where the novel opens now houses the James Joyce Tower and Museum.
texts.it: La torre costiera in cui si apre il romanzo ospita oggi il James Joyce Tower and Museum.
texts.fr: La tour côtière où s’ouvre le roman abrite aujourd’hui le James Joyce Tower and Museum.
texts.es: La torre costera donde comienza la novela alberga hoy el James Joyce Tower and Museum.

description.basis: existing geographic and literary sources associated with this place

texts.en: The Forty Foot is the bathing place on the shore below Sandycove, where Mulligan goes swimming.
texts.it: Il Forty Foot è il luogo di balneazione sulla costa sotto Sandycove, dove Mulligan va a nuotare.
texts.fr: Le Forty Foot est le lieu de baignade sur la côte en contrebas de Sandycove, où Mulligan va nager.
texts.es: El Forty Foot es la zona de baño de la costa bajo Sandycove, donde Mulligan va a nadar.

description.basis: existing geographic and literary sources associated with this place

texts.en: The surviving chapter house of St Mary’s Abbey is visited by Ned Lambert and Reverend Love.
texts.it: La sala capitolare superstite dell’abbazia di St Mary è visitata da Ned Lambert e dal reverendo Love.
texts.fr: Ned Lambert et le révérend Love visitent la salle capitulaire conservée de l’abbaye Sainte-Marie.
texts.es: Ned Lambert y el reverendo Love visitan la sala capitular conservada de la abadía de Santa María.

description.basis: existing geographic and literary sources associated with this place

texts.en: Bloom watches the time signal at the former Ballast Office; the historical building no longer stands.
texts.it: Bloom osserva il segnale orario del vecchio Ballast Office, edificio storico oggi scomparso.
texts.fr: Bloom observe le signal horaire de l’ancien Ballast Office, bâtiment historique aujourd’hui disparu.
texts.es: Bloom observa la señal horaria del antiguo Ballast Office, edificio histórico hoy desaparecido.

description.basis: existing geographic and literary sources associated with this place

texts.en: At Burton’s restaurant Bloom recoils from the sight of the diners and leaves.
texts.it: Nel ristorante Burton Bloom è disgustato dalla vista degli avventori e se ne va.
texts.fr: Au restaurant Burton, Bloom est dégoûté par les clients et repart.
texts.es: En el restaurante Burton, Bloom se disgusta al ver a los comensales y se marcha.

description.basis: existing geographic and literary sources associated with this place

texts.en: Davy Byrne’s is the pub where Bloom lunches on a gorgonzola sandwich and Burgundy.
texts.it: Da Davy Byrne Bloom pranza con un panino al gorgonzola e un bicchiere di Borgogna.
texts.fr: Chez Davy Byrne, Bloom déjeune d’un sandwich au gorgonzola et d’un verre de bourgogne.
texts.es: En Davy Byrne’s, Bloom almuerza un sándwich de gorgonzola y vino de Borgoña.

description.basis: existing geographic and literary sources associated with this place

texts.en: The funeral procession passes City Hall as it turns from the quays towards Dame Street.
texts.it: Il corteo funebre passa davanti alla City Hall mentre dai moli svolta verso Dame Street.
texts.fr: Le cortège funèbre passe devant le City Hall en quittant les quais pour Dame Street.
texts.es: El cortejo fúnebre pasa ante el City Hall al girar desde los muelles hacia Dame Street.

description.basis: existing geographic and literary sources associated with this place

texts.en: The Four Courts complex stands along the quays passed by Dignam’s funeral procession.
texts.it: Il complesso dei Four Courts sorge lungo i moli percorsi dal corteo funebre di Dignam.
texts.fr: Le complexe des Four Courts longe les quais empruntés par le cortège funèbre de Dignam.
texts.es: El complejo de los Four Courts se alza junto a los muelles que recorre el cortejo fúnebre de Dignam.

description.basis: existing geographic and literary sources associated with this place

texts.en: Bloom passes Freemasons’ Hall, the headquarters of the Masonic organisation.
texts.it: Bloom passa davanti alla Freemasons’ Hall, sede dell’organizzazione massonica.
texts.fr: Bloom passe devant le Freemasons’ Hall, siège de l’organisation maçonnique.
texts.es: Bloom pasa ante el Freemasons’ Hall, sede de la organización masónica.

description.basis: existing geographic and literary sources associated with this place

texts.en: The bells of St George’s Church mark both the beginning of the day and the return at night.
texts.it: Le campane della chiesa di St George scandiscono l’inizio della giornata e il ritorno notturno.
texts.fr: Les cloches de l’église Saint-Georges marquent le début de la journée et le retour nocturne.
texts.es: Las campanas de la iglesia de San Jorge marcan el comienzo del día y el regreso nocturno.

description.basis: existing geographic and literary sources associated with this place

texts.en: Dublin’s General Post Office stands in the city-centre setting of the newspaper episode.
texts.it: Il General Post Office di Dublino sorge nel centro cittadino, nell’ambientazione dell’episodio dei giornali.
texts.fr: La poste centrale de Dublin se trouve dans le centre où se déroule l’épisode des journaux.
texts.es: La oficina central de correos de Dublín está en el centro donde transcurre el episodio de los periódicos.

description.basis: existing geographic and literary sources associated with this place

texts.en: Grattan Bridge, also known as Essex Bridge, is crossed by the procession and other characters.
texts.it: Il Grattan Bridge, detto anche Essex Bridge, è attraversato dal corteo e da altri personaggi.
texts.fr: Le pont Grattan, aussi appelé Essex Bridge, est traversé par le cortège et d’autres personnages.
texts.es: El puente Grattan, también llamado Essex Bridge, lo cruzan el cortejo y otros personajes.

description.basis: existing geographic and literary sources associated with this place

texts.en: Stephen’s discussion of Shakespeare takes place in the National Library of Ireland.
texts.it: La discussione di Stephen su Shakespeare si svolge nella National Library of Ireland.
texts.fr: La discussion de Stephen sur Shakespeare se déroule à la Bibliothèque nationale d’Irlande.
texts.es: La conversación de Stephen sobre Shakespeare transcurre en la Biblioteca Nacional de Irlanda.

description.basis: existing geographic and literary sources associated with this place

texts.en: Bloom turns towards the National Museum of Ireland to avoid Boylan.
texts.it: Bloom si dirige verso il National Museum of Ireland per evitare Boylan.
texts.fr: Bloom se dirige vers le Musée national d’Irlande pour éviter Boylan.
texts.es: Bloom se dirige hacia el Museo Nacional de Irlanda para evitar a Boylan.

description.basis: existing geographic and literary sources associated with this place

texts.en: Nelson’s Pillar, a Dublin landmark mentioned in the novel, was destroyed in 1966.
texts.it: La Nelson’s Pillar, monumento di Dublino citato nel romanzo, fu distrutta nel 1966.
texts.fr: La colonne Nelson, monument de Dublin mentionné dans le roman, fut détruite en 1966.
texts.es: La columna de Nelson, monumento de Dublín mencionado en la novela, fue destruida en 1966.

description.basis: existing geographic and literary sources associated with this place

texts.en: At the former Westland Row post office Bloom collects a letter addressed to Henry Flower.
texts.it: Nel vecchio ufficio postale di Westland Row Bloom ritira una lettera indirizzata a Henry Flower.
texts.fr: À l’ancien bureau de poste de Westland Row, Bloom retire une lettre adressée à Henry Flower.
texts.es: En la antigua oficina de correos de Westland Row, Bloom recoge una carta dirigida a Henry Flower.

description.basis: existing geographic and literary sources associated with this place

texts.en: At Sweny’s pharmacy Bloom buys the lemon soap he carries through Dublin.
texts.it: Nella farmacia Sweny Bloom acquista il sapone al limone che porterà con sé per Dublino.
texts.fr: À la pharmacie Sweny, Bloom achète le savon au citron qu’il emporte dans Dublin.
texts.es: En la farmacia Sweny, Bloom compra el jabón de limón que lleva por Dublín.

description.basis: existing geographic and literary sources associated with this place

texts.en: The National Maternity Hospital on Holles Street is the setting of the gathering in Oxen of the Sun.
texts.it: Il National Maternity Hospital di Holles Street ospita la riunione nell’episodio I buoi del Sole.
texts.fr: Le National Maternity Hospital de Holles Street accueille la réunion de l’épisode Les Bœufs du Soleil.
texts.es: El National Maternity Hospital de Holles Street acoge la reunión del episodio Los bueyes del Sol.

description.basis: existing geographic and literary sources associated with this place

texts.en: The offices of the Freeman’s Journal and Evening Telegraph stood on Prince’s Street.
texts.it: Le redazioni del Freeman’s Journal e dell’Evening Telegraph si trovavano in Prince’s Street.
texts.fr: Les bureaux du Freeman’s Journal et de l’Evening Telegraph se trouvaient sur Prince’s Street.
texts.es: Las oficinas del Freeman’s Journal y del Evening Telegraph estaban en Prince’s Street.

description.basis: existing geographic and literary sources associated with this place

texts.en: Bloom’s home at 7 Eccles Street was demolished; its door is preserved at the James Joyce Centre.
texts.it: La casa di Bloom al 7 di Eccles Street è stata demolita; la porta è conservata al James Joyce Centre.
texts.fr: La maison de Bloom au 7 Eccles Street a été démolie ; sa porte est conservée au James Joyce Centre.
texts.es: La casa de Bloom en el 7 de Eccles Street fue demolida; su puerta se conserva en el James Joyce Centre.

description.basis: existing geographic and literary sources associated with this place

texts.en: Barney Kiernan’s pub, the setting of the confrontation in Cyclops, no longer stands.
texts.it: Il pub di Barney Kiernan, teatro del confronto nel Ciclope, oggi non esiste più.
texts.fr: Le pub de Barney Kiernan, cadre de l’affrontement dans Le Cyclope, n’existe plus.
texts.es: El pub de Barney Kiernan, escenario del enfrentamiento en Cíclope, ya no existe.

description.basis: existing geographic and literary sources associated with this place

texts.en: The cabmen’s shelter near the railway bridge no longer exists; Bloom and Stephen stop there at night.
texts.it: Il rifugio dei vetturini presso il ponte ferroviario, dove Bloom e Stephen si fermano di notte, non esiste più.
texts.fr: L’abri des cochers près du pont ferroviaire, où Bloom et Stephen s’arrêtent la nuit, a disparu.
texts.es: El refugio de cocheros junto al puente ferroviario, donde Bloom y Stephen se detienen de noche, ya no existe.

description.basis: existing geographic and literary sources associated with this place

texts.en: At the entrance to Trinity College, Stephen meets the singing teacher Almidano Artifoni.
texts.it: All’ingresso del Trinity College Stephen incontra il maestro di canto Almidano Artifoni.
texts.fr: À l’entrée de Trinity College, Stephen rencontre le professeur de chant Almidano Artifoni.
texts.es: A la entrada del Trinity College, Stephen se encuentra con el profesor de canto Almidano Artifoni.
